canon_rules: Setting: circa 2036, ~5 years after the modern collapse; recognisably contemporary, scarcity-driven, not generic cyberpunk
Canon identities include Cipher, Wind, Water, Fire, Earth and Dark; the post-comic game has five playable factions (Wind, Water, Fire, Earth, Dark), with Cipher as a non-playable allied AI

Game chronology: the operative’s continuation begins after the comic; Cipher welcomes operatives and speaks after every tower clear. The Eastern Expanse beyond Tower 5 is proposed game content, not established source-comic canon.
25 original ability modules, 5 per elemental domain; modules can be stolen, recovered, transferred or shared
Spirits are intelligent agents with their own consent; they are never obedient buttons
The ancient catastrophe and the modern collapse (~2031) are distinct events; towers regulate environmental systems and their restoration is never a planetary reset
The system virus grew from the Kael family's failed secret extension project (target 30 abilities, stopped at the 26th); the endgame is the Rebind requiring willing spirit cooperation
Ajaye's green Cipher Sleeve appears on ONE arm only; never both, never mirrored
Power has cost: finite Sleeve energy, host condition and spirit activity are three distinct interacting factors
session_rules: Every session reads memory/ chapters first (start at memory/00-index.md, follow memory/01-session-protocol.md)
One system per build: build, npm test, commit, update memory, then start the next
New systems are plug-and-play modules auto-scanned from server/modules/ and public/src/modules/ — small files (<150 lines), one job, novice-friendly; never edit the master to add a feature
Canon is law: lore/ + memory/02-universe-canon.md; raise conflicts, never invent lore
Save state after every build (memory/05-work-state.md + this ledger) so interruptions never lose work

Camera system (public/src/camera.js): smooth follow, look-ahead, auto/scroll/key zoom, viewport culling and minimap with world markers
Client-side interpolation (public/src/interpolation.js): remote players and projectiles render ~100ms behind, blended between snapshots, capped extrapolation
Sprite pipeline: dependency-free PNG baker (tools/png.js, npm run sprites) bakes per-domain idle + 4-frame walk sheets, a 6-variant ruined tile sheet and warden.png into public/assets/
Baked background: static floor and perimeter bands rasterised once into an offscreen canvas and blitted per visible region (single re-bake if tile art loads late)
Five playable signature abilities: Gale Push (wind), Tide Snare (water), Ember Lance (fire), Bulwark wall (earth), Void Siphon (dark); Cipher has no selectable ability
Status effects: slow, haste, burn, plus a timed shield window; Bulwark walls are destructible and block projectiles
Downed/respawn loop: kill credit, combat:hit / combat:down / combat:respawn events consumed by the client for feedback
Rust Warden PvE drones: patrol/wander, aggro ring, chase, hostile server-resolved fire, shared damageableTargets list, 9s respawn, XP + skill point payout, minimap markers and kill feed entries
Swept-path projectile collision so fast shots no longer tunnel through targets
Domination mode: relays captured by standing uncontested, mixed factions freeze capture, held relays score per second, capture XP, per-arena score limits and tower reset, faction scoreboard

Progression: single applyXp funnel (warden kills, player kills, relay captures, Core points, archive echoes), XP curve in server/progression.js (xpForLevel/levelFromXp, level cap 40), each level grants a skill point and +10 max HP, level:up broadcast, HUD level/XP bar, persisted XP and level

Plug-and-play server module system: server/module-loader.js auto-scans server/modules/*.js at boot with a shared context (hook-bus events joining/joined/left/persist/tick, registerSocket, route, distance, applyXp, persistPlayer, xpScale); broken modules are skipped, never fatal

Archive story terminals (Roadmap #10, COMPLETE): server module archive-terminals.js (3 canon-lore terminals, once-per-operative XP + core bounty, terminalsRead persisted) + client module terminals.js (beacons, READ prompt on F/Y/touch, lore log panel); interact key bound in keyboard, gamepad and touch input

Plug-and-play client module system: public/src/plugin-host.js hook bus + public/src/module-runner.js fetching /api/client-modules (server rescans per request), parallel import then priority-ordered setup with loading-screen progress callbacks; renderer emits render:world / render:fx / render:overlay hooks
Boot priority ordering: server and client modules may declare priority (lower boots first, default 50) so boot order is deterministic and optimisable
Loading screen boot status: title screen shows real module boot progress via #boot-status, fed by the module runner
World decoration module (world-decor.js): deterministic ruin props and named landmark labels drawn under moving entities
Combat juice module (roadmap #11, COMPLETE): combat-juice.js draws hit sparks, floating damage numbers, afterimages and proximity screenshake from server combat events
Collapsible Chat Box

Six instanced arena modes: PvP/PvE domination, team deathmatch and tower capture

dev_notes: SESSION BOOTSTRAP: read memory/00-index.md first and follow memory/01-session-protocol.md (one system per build, plug-and-play modules only, save state after each build). Client is split into small browser ES modules under public/src/ (assetLoader, audioManager, camera, characterRenderer, config, inputManager, interpolation, keybinds, menu, menu-pages, netcode, renderer, uiManager, world). public/client.js is the master orchestrator. Server logic lives in server.js with pure helpers extracted to server/ (progression.js, shop-catalog.js, skill-tree.js). Procedural rendering remains active when optional files under public/assets/ are absent; regenerate baked sprites with 'npm run sprites'. The top-centre summary in public/src/hud.js omits health; level, credits, zone and ability remain in a compact card, while XP is a 3px line at the absolute viewport top. Card geometry still derives from the #hud-center DOM slot. All HUD/menu measurements come from :root variables in public/index.html (--radar-*, --hud-*, --joy, --tap*, env() safe areas), so mobile sizing is tuned in one place. Every zone in server/zones-catalog.js declares a `biome` (grass, wasteland, water, earth, fire, wind, cipher, arena); public/src/biomes.js paints them and renderer.js caches one background canvas per biome + world size, so never hardcode floor colours in renderer.js — add a painter and a biome tag instead. Factions use the existing domain field: server/modules/player-customisation.js resolves the join payload's `faction` into energyColor/color/accent and owns the suit palette; palette ids/hexes must be mirrored in server/player-palettes.js and public/src/config.js (a test enforces parity), and the cosmetic overlay lives in public/src/characterRenderer.js. MENU pages live in public/src/menu-pages.js: Character is stats/identity, Inventory owns the paperdoll and equipped gear, Skills holds core upgrades plus the tree; server/skill-tree.js owns node validation and skillBonuses(), which server/sim/abilities.js and the dash handler apply so unlocked nodes change gameplay. Tests run with 'npm test' (node --test) against a scratch profile file (PROFILE_FILE from tools/profile-scratch.js), so persisted credits/HP never leak between runs; and cover abilities, wardens, objectives, progression, camera, interpolation, renderer, sprites, modules, skill-tree bonuses and the server. Ajaye's segmented Cipher Sleeve is rendered on his anatomical left arm only; his right arm remains ordinary clothing and skin. Universe canon lives in lore/ (see lore/README.md): any new lore-bearing content (terminal logs, item names, abilities, characters) must fit those documents, and canon conflicts are raised with the project owner rather than silently resolved. Optional username/password accounts live in server/modules/auth.js with server/account-store.js; users.json is ignored and separate from guest profiles. Auth is currently unverified; no email verification/reset or guest-profile migration exists yet. Wilderness hazards are modular: server/modules/zone-hazards.js owns five road fields, phase timing and damage; public/src/modules/zone-hazards.js renders server-timed rings. Test coverage is in test/zone-hazards.test.js but has not been run. Visual audit confirmed all five playable faction idle/walk sprite pairs, the Warden sprite and ruin tiles exist with procedural fallbacks; all biomes have painters and tower rooms have procedural art. Fixed missing biome propagation into live zone state and tower name/tint wiring. test/visuals.test.js was added but not run; no new images were generated because no visual category lacked a rendered or fallback visual. Selectable shooting styles: Settings stores auto-aim or twin-stick in localStorage; public/src/shooting.js selects the nearest living Warden (or opposing PvP-arena player) as a client aim direction, while shootingControls.js handles mouse, gamepad and touch aim plus held fire at 500 ms. Touch aim-stick deflection fires while held. The server remains authoritative for cadence, safe-zone protection, collisions and damage. test/shooting.test.js was added but not run; no shell/browser runner was available, so this feature remains unverified and uncommitted. Post-comic game continuation: five playable factions (Wind, Water, Earth, Fire, Dark); legacy Cipher profiles migrate to Wind. Cipher is an allied AI introduced once after the operative’s first clear of any tower. New companion client/server modules, hologram SVG portrait, and regression coverage were added; npm test/browser checks could not be run in this workspace, so changes remain unverified and uncommitted. Step 13: server/secure-transport.js recognizes native secure requests, the-5-sleeves.onrender.com forwarded HTTPS, and explicitly trusted proxies; server.js passes it to auth. Controller layout is A=interact/confirm, RT=blast, B=dash/back, Y=shield, X/RB=ability, with left-stick/D-pad focus navigation for title/menu/modal overlays. Touch and server/socket controls remain on their existing paths. HUD removed its duplicate health bar, draws a 3px XP line at screen top, and stacks toast/banner/kill notices below the left minimap. Added auth/input/HUD/renderer regression tests; tests and browser checks could not run (no shell/browser runner), so implementation remains unverified and uncommitted. Step 14 PWA/fullscreen: static Express serving exposes public/manifest.json automatically. Manifest config uses display=standalone, orientation=landscape and requested colors; index.html adds Apple web-app metadata. Settings uses standard requestFullscreen/exitFullscreen from a user gesture, syncs after fullscreenchange, and gracefully directs unsupported browsers to Home Screen standalone launch. Browser support differs on iOS, so universal fullscreen cannot be assumed. Added test/pwa.test.js; tests and device/browser checks are unrun, so this build remains unverified. New owner request (implemented, unverified): Cipher welcomes each joined operative; first-contact persistence stays, but every tower clear gets a separate Cipher dialogue. Tower 5 east exit is per-operative gated by persisted towers[5], and opens the new 3000×2100 Eastern Expanse. Five empty marked boss sites are visual placeholders; five existing Rust Wardens are placed as guardians. No boss or enemy type added. World dimensions flow through zone metadata/client state. Eastern Expanse is proposed game content beyond the source comic, whose canon documents remain unchanged. Added test/endgame.test.js and extended test/world.test.js; neither suite nor browser playtest was run because no shell/browser runner is available. Owner request: safe-city Cipher Cores now heal 3% max HP/sec while a living operative is inside the Core radius; healing clamps at max HP and only occurs in haven zones. Existing inactivity-gated meditation credits remain unchanged. Added rate/cap/zone/leave regression coverage to test/core-meditation.test.js. Tests and gameplay were not run (no shell/browser runner). Following one-system-per-build protocol, the separately approved tougher-but-fair wilderness/tower difficulty curve and five-faction passive/special skill tree remain queued, not implemented. Step 15 PWA service worker: public/sw.js caches the app shell and uses network-first static GET with offline fallback; bypasses socket.io, APIs, non-GET and cross-origin requests. Registered after load; manifest uses a scalable SVG icon. Added service-worker regression assertions in test/pwa.test.js. npm test and browser/device checks were not run; installability is not guaranteed across all browsers/platforms and must be verified over HTTPS on devices. iPad touch fix: public/src/inputManager.js now listens for touch pointerdown and touchstart to switch into touch controls even if startup detection selected keyboard; inputModeForPointer helper and test/input.test.js regression added. Test suite and iPad Safari playtesting not run. Added CONTENT_EDITING_GUIDE.md to map existing editable values for Warden enemies, items, XP, credits, region danger and objective scoring; current source still requires code changes to add new AI behavior. Added test/content-guide.test.js; tests not run. No game balance changed. Next build: data-driven enemy definitions and behavior hooks, then add requested drones/enemy sizes/boss as separate content slices. Altered fauna is proposed game content pending canon review.
